(RS_AP_00130, RS_AP_00122, RS_AP_00127, RS_AP_00154)
Please note
Execution Management
intentionally violates [SWS_CORE_90006]
here. Violation handling as required by [SWS_CORE_90006] leads to
Unexpected
Termination
, which would be reported to and handled by
State Management
.
Note that for APIs intended to be used by
State Management
itself, this error han-
dling strategy is not considered to contribute to robust system design (
State Man-
agement
would be terminated by [SWS_CORE_90006]). Therefore ara::exec APIs
which are intended to be used by
State Management
return
kMetaModelError
in-
stead, as this allows implementation of fallback strategies within
State Management
.
